Tiger Legatus Capital Management Upped Stake in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) by $5.16 Million; Sanctuary Wealth Advisors Position in Weight Watchers Interntional (WTW) Lowered as Valuation Rose
May 20, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Jesse Ro increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 54.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tiger Legatus Capital Management Llc bought 30,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Jesse Ro held 85,000 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.66M, up from 55,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tiger Legatus Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $501.05 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $1.02 $195. About 14.24 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Sanctuary Wealth Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Weight Watchers Interntional (WTW) by 1.23% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sanctuary Wealth Advisors Llc sold 1,071 shares as the company’s stock rose 23.71% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 86,055 shares of the other consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $38.11 million, down from 87,126 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sanctuary Wealth Advisors Llc who had been investing in Weight Watchers Interntional for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.23B market cap company. The stock decreased 4.53% or $3.75 $78.95. About 2.19M shares traded or 17.66% up from the average. Weight Watchers International, Inc. (NYSE:WTW) has risen 313.09% uptrending. It has outperformed by 301.54% the S&P500.
